grammar.purpose: Distinguish a purpose from a recipient or cause
grammar.explanation: 为了方便带书 states the intended goal. 为朋友准备礼物 identifies the beneficiary instead. 因为她喜欢读书 gives a cause motivating the choice. An intended purpose is not proof that the goal has already been achieved; ask whether the bag fits the recipient’s books.

examples.zh: 为了方便带书，我选了布袋。
examples.py: wèi le fāng biàn dài shū , wǒ xuǎn le bù dài .
examples.en: To make carrying books easier, I chose a cloth bag.

examples.zh: 为了纪念第一次见面，我选了照片。
examples.py: wèi le jì niàn dì yī cì jiàn miàn , wǒ xuǎn le zhào piān .
examples.en: To commemorate the first meeting, I chose a photo.

examples.zh: 因为她喜欢读书，我为她准备布袋。
examples.py: yīn wèi tā xǐ huān dú shū , wǒ wèi tā zhǔn bèi bù dài .
examples.en: Because she likes reading, I prepared a cloth bag for her.

commonMistakes.wrong: 为了方便带书，所以已经证明袋子合适。
commonMistakes.right: 为了方便带书选布袋，还要看大小是否合适。
commonMistakes.why: An intention does not verify suitability.

grammar.purpose: Link an intended purpose to the chosen action
grammar.explanation: 为了节约材料，我用了已有的纸 presents goal then action. It does not require 所以; distinguish causal 因为……所以 from purposive 为了. The alternative 我用了已有的纸，为了节约材料 is possible with context, but the exercise asks for the ordinary initial-purpose ordering. Keep the action concrete and verify the result separately.

examples.zh: 为了节约材料，我用了已有的纸。
examples.py: wèi le jié yuē cái liào , wǒ yòng le yǐ yǒu de zhǐ .
examples.en: To save materials, I used paper already available.

examples.zh: 为了让她方便带书，我选了布袋。
examples.py: wèi le ràng tā fāng biàn dài shū , wǒ xuǎn le bù dài .
examples.en: To let her carry books conveniently, I chose a cloth bag.

examples.zh: 为了说明作者，我在卡片上写了名字。
examples.py: wèi le shuō míng zuò zhě , wǒ zài kǎ piàn shàng xiě le míng zi .
examples.en: To identify the creator, I wrote the name on the card.

commonMistakes.wrong: 为了她喜欢读书，我买了袋子。
commonMistakes.right: 因为她喜欢读书，我买了袋子。
commonMistakes.why: Her existing preference is a cause; use 为了 for a goal to achieve.

dialogue.title: A useful bag and an original card
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find why the gift was chosen and what was actually paid.

lines.zh: 你为什么选布袋，不选金色盒子？
lines.py: nǐ wèi shén me xuǎn bù dài , bù xuǎn jīn sè hé zi ?
lines.en: Why choose a cloth bag instead of a gold-coloured box?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 为了方便她带书，布袋的功能更适合。
lines.py: wèi le fāng biàn tā dài shū , bù dài de gōng néng gèng shì hé .
lines.en: To make carrying books easier for her; the bag’s function is more suitable.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 金色盒子是金做的吗？
lines.py: jīn sè hé zi shì jīn zuò de ma ?
lines.en: Is the gold-coloured box made of gold?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，只是颜色。银色包装也不一定是银。
lines.py: bù shì , zhǐ shì yán sè . yín sè bāo zhuāng yě bù yí dìng shì yín .
lines.en: No, just the colour. Silver-coloured packaging is not necessarily silver either.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这张彩色贺卡是谁创作的？
lines.py: zhè zhāng cǎi sè hè kǎ shì shéi chuàng zuò de ?
lines.en: Who created this coloured greeting card?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我自己写的，照片是朋友拍的，作者都写清楚了。
lines.py: wǒ zì jǐ xiě de , zhào piān shì péng you pāi de , zuò zhě dōu xiě qīng chǔ le .
lines.en: I wrote it myself; a friend took the photo, and all creators are identified.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 材料花了多少？
lines.py: cái liào huā le duō shao ?
lines.en: How much did the materials cost?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 二十块现金，用了已有的纸，没有超过预算。
lines.py: èr shí kuài xiàn jīn , yòng le yǐ yǒu de zhǐ , méi yǒu chāo guò yù suàn .
lines.en: Twenty yuan cash; used paper already available and did not exceed the budget.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Usefulness, clear authorship and a budget
questions.answer: Usefulness, clear authorship and a budget

reading.title: A gift note without inflated claims
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read the purpose, the authors and the material.

lines.zh: 为了方便朋友带书，我选了一个布袋，先确认大小。
lines.py: wèi le fāng biàn péng you dài shū , wǒ xuǎn le yī gè bù dài , xiān què rèn dà xiǎo .
lines.en: To make carrying books easier, I chose a cloth bag and checked the size first.

lines.zh: 布袋的设计实用，功能是装书，不是表示消费多少。
lines.py: bù dài de shè jì shí yòng , gōng néng shì zhuāng shū , bù shì biǎo shì xiāo fèi duō shao .
lines.en: The bag’s design is practical; its function is carrying books, not displaying spending.

lines.zh: 为了节约材料，我利用已有的纸创作彩色贺卡。
lines.py: wèi le jié yuē cái liào , wǒ lì yòng yǐ yǒu de zhǐ chuàng zuò cǎi sè hè kǎ .
lines.en: To save materials, I used existing paper to create a coloured greeting card.

lines.zh: 照片是朋友的作品，卡片说明作者，不把别人的作品当成自己创作。
lines.py: zhào piān shì péng you de zuò pǐn , kǎ piàn shuō míng zuò zhě , bù bǎ bié ren de zuò pǐn dàng chéng zì jǐ chuàng zuò .
lines.en: The photo is my friend’s work; the card identifies the creator rather than claiming another’s work as mine.

lines.zh: 为了纪念第一次见面，选照片；为了表达祝福，写一句汉语。
lines.py: wèi le jì niàn dì yī cì jiàn miàn , xuǎn zhào piān ; wèi le biǎo dá zhù fú , xiě yī jù hàn yǔ .
lines.en: To commemorate the first meeting, choose a photo; to express good wishes, write a Mandarin sentence.

lines.zh: 金色和银色是颜色说明，不保证材料里有金或银。
lines.py: jīn sè hé yín sè shì yán sè shuō míng , bù bǎo zhèng cái liào lǐ yǒu jīn huò yín .
lines.en: Gold and silver colour describe appearance; they do not guarantee gold or silver content.

lines.zh: 材料付了二十块现金，没有超过预算；过多包装会浪费。
lines.py: cái liào fù le èr shí kuài xiàn jīn , méi yǒu chāo guò yù suàn ; guò duō bāo zhuāng huì làng fèi .
lines.en: Materials cost twenty yuan cash within budget; excessive packaging would waste resources.

lines.zh: 把知识应用到实际表达，创造回忆，不必用价格证明爱心。
lines.py: bǎ zhī shi yìng yòng dào shí jì biǎo dá , chuàng zào huí yì , bù bì yòng jià gé zhèng míng ài xīn .
lines.en: Apply knowledge to real expression and create memories; no need to prove care through price.
